Engineering Manager

Fictional Meadow Software

FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION FOR APP TESTING

Manage a team of eight engineers, balancing people development, delivery and technical quality.

REQUIRED

- Own regular one-to-ones, performance feedback and career development.

- Participate in hiring and handle difficult people-management situations.

- Set realistic delivery plans and resolve cross-team dependencies.

- Guide technical tradeoffs and improve incident learning.

- Communicate risks clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience moving from technical leadership into formal line management.

INTERVIEW STAGE

Hiring manager discussion focused on leadership examples.
